content: प्रचुद् €10 <ab>U.</ab> ²1 To impel, prompt, urge, incite; धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात् <ls>Gāyatrīmantra</ls>; चापलाय प्रचोदितः <ls>R. 1. 9</ls>. .²2 To drive or urge on, push on. .²3 To excite, inspire, encourage, incite, stimulate. .²4 To enjoin, direct, prescribe. .²5 To request, ask. .²6 To fix, settle, determine. .²7 To proclaim, announce; परिवेषयेत प्रयतो गुणान् सर्वान् प्रचोदयन् <ls>Ms. 3. 228</ls>.
